sentences.cn: 出现意见分歧表明该党内部的关系紧张。

sentences.c: The city's problems are symptomatic of the crisis that is spreading throughout the country.
sentences.cn: 这个城市的问题是正在席卷全国的这场危机的征兆。

sentences.c: It is symptomatic of the swing between the outright rejection and qualified acceptance of the medium that was fairly typical of the artistic establishment.
sentences.cn: 它显现了在彻底拒绝和有条件地接受这一媒介的两者之间的摇摆不定，而这正是艺术机构的典型特征。
